page.layout: One block of text, one column, centred on the page; below the last line a signature line with catchword-like marks ("a 3" and "Au-"). No margin notes.

main_text.p: ferta, quot dignitates, & decora, virtute, nomine, fatisq; tuis praefignata, sese habitu-ram confidat. Si liberi, quidem paucis autem Siluester hoc reuera nomen est, quod syl-uam implet encomiorum. Valerius non aliunde maioris pretij valor, quàm ex hoc ti-tulo venit. Procurator laus videtur eximia, eo murice ni-tere, quo soli Heroes in tua Rep. fulgent. Bertuccij Filius nil poterat fortuna largiri ma-ius, quàm Patrem habere il-lum, in quo Venetus Leo subni-xus Throno alterum sustinuit Salomonem. Equesg Germa-niae, Hispaniaeque, hinc re-cordamur Legationem, qua-nuper ad Margaritam Mariam

page.notes: Partly illegible: the printed lines are faint and overlapped by show-through and stains; several words ("ferta", "Equesg", "Siluester", "Rep.") are doubtful. Foot line with the signature marks and a stamp at the bottom is not transcribed as text. Marks such as "a 3" are signature and page number. Possible errors in the transcription of the running lines; please verify against the scan.
